confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from external SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, massive database querying, and subsequent data exfiltration via DNS and HTTPS, followed by log tampering to hide tracks.

attack_chain.description: External attacker (162.247.74.27) performs SQL injection attempts using sqlmap against the web server.
Attacker successfully logs into user_01's account from the same malicious IP (162.247.74.27), which is outside user_01's normal IP and hours.
Attacker escalates privileges of user_01 to 'dba' (database administrator).
Attacker uses the elevated privileges to log into the 'prod_main' database.
Attacker executes large-scale queries to extract customer data (over 1.5 million rows across multiple queries).
Attacker begins data exfiltration via DNS tunneling to a known malicious domain (x7353.malicious-94.com).
Attacker performs large-scale data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP 443) to an external destination.
Attacker attempts to cover tracks by deleting/truncating the authentication logs (/var/log/auth.log).

gaps: Confirmation of whether the SQL injection (evt_s93_001-004) was the direct mechanism used to obtain user_01's credentials.
Identification of the destination IP for the HTTPS exfiltration (evt_s93_047-051).
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection to compromise user_01's credentials and subsequently escalated their privileges to DBA. After querying massive amounts of customer data from the production database, the attacker exfiltrated the data via DNS and HTTPS before deleting authentication logs to evade detection.
